import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyWeilDivisor
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.ResidueDegree
import Mathlib.RingTheory.LocalRing.Length

/-!
# Residue-weighted lengths for divisor families

The degree of an effective divisor counts the length of its quotient stalk at
each closed point, weighted by the degree of the residue field. The local
calculation below identifies this contribution with the dimension of the
actual quotient stalk over the base field. This is the local algebra input
for the finite-support global-section calculation in Kleiman, Section 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

section LocalLength

variable {K R M : Type*} [Field K] [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
  [Algebra K R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module K M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M]

/-- Restricting a local module to the ground field weights its local length
by the dimension of the residue field. -/
theorem length_field_eq_length_mul_finrank_residue
    [Module.Finite K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)] :
    Module.length K M = Module.length R M *
      (Module.finrank K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) : ℕ∞) := by
  rw [IsLocalRing.length_restrictScalars K R M]
  congr 1
  rw [← Module.length_eq_of_surjective (M := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
    (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := K)), Module.length_eq_finrank]

/-- Finite local length and finite residue degree make a module finite over
the ground field. -/
theorem module_finite_field_of_isFiniteLength
    [Module.Finite K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) : Module.Finite K M := by
  have hlen : Module.length K M ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [length_field_eq_length_mul_finrank_residue (R := R)]
    lift Module.length R M to ℕ using Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr hM with n hn
    rw [← Nat.cast_mul]
    exact ENat.coe_ne_top _
  have hfin : IsFiniteLength K M := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hlen
  letI : _root_.IsNoetherian K M := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfin).1
  infer_instance

/-- The vector-space dimension of a finite local module is its local length
times its residue degree. Both finite dimensions are genuine dimensions. -/
theorem finrank_eq_length_mul_finrank_residue
    [Module.Finite K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    (Module.finrank K M : ℕ∞) = Module.length R M *
      (Module.finrank K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) : ℕ∞) := by
  letI : Module.Finite K M := module_finite_field_of_isFiniteLength hM
  rw [← Module.length_eq_finrank]
  exact length_field_eq_length_mul_finrank_residue

end LocalLength

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace Scheme.Modules

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- The structural action of the ground field on a module stalk. -/
noncomputable abbrev stalkOverModule (F : X.Modules) (x : X) :
    Module K (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
  letI := presheafStalkModule F.val x
  Module.compHom _ ((X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.comp (X.overAlgebraMap K ⊤))

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The dimension of a finite-length quotient stalk is its intrinsic local
length weighted by the degree of its residue field. -/
theorem finrank_stalk_eq_stalkLength_mul_residueDeg
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (F : X.Modules) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hlen : stalkLength F x ≠ ⊤) :
    letI := stalkOverModule K F x
    (Module.finrank K (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) : ℕ∞) =
      stalkLength F x * (X.residueDeg K x : ℕ∞) := by
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule F.val x
  letI : Algebra K (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ((X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.comp (X.overAlgebraMap K ⊤)).toAlgebra
  letI := stalkOverModule K F x
  letI : IsScalarTower K (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul (fun _ _ => rfl)
  haveI : Module.Finite K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    Scheme.residueDeg_finite hx
  exact finrank_eq_length_mul_finrank_residue (R := X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hlen)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A finite-length stalk on a smooth curve is finite-dimensional over the
ground field. The residue extension is finite by the closed-point theorem. -/
theorem module_finite_stalk_of_stalkLength_ne_top
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (F : X.Modules) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hlen : stalkLength F x ≠ ⊤) :
    letI := stalkOverModule K F x
    Module.Finite K (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) := by
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    presheafStalkModule F.val x
  letI : Algebra K (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ((X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.comp (X.overAlgebraMap K ⊤)).toAlgebra
  letI := stalkOverModule K F x
  letI : IsScalarTower K (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) : Type u) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul (fun _ _ => rfl)
  haveI : Module.Finite K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    Scheme.residueDeg_finite hx
  exact module_finite_field_of_isFiniteLength (R := X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hlen)

end Scheme.Modules

namespace Scheme.DivFamily

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
  {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance fieldTestIsIntegral : IsIntegral (pullback π s) :=
  fieldTest_isIntegral (π := π) (s := s)
noncomputable local instance fieldTestOver : (pullback π s).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  .ofHom (pullback.snd π s)
local instance fieldTestSmoothBase : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    (pullback.snd π s) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)
local instance fieldTestSmoothField : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)
local instance fieldTestLocallyOfFiniteType : LocallyOfFiniteType
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd π s))

/-- An actual field-test Cartier quotient stalk is finite-dimensional over
the field, at every closed point. -/
theorem module_finite_stalk (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (z : {z : (pullback π s : Scheme) // z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)}) :
    letI := Modules.stalkOverModule K (X := pullback π s) x.F z.1
    Module.Finite K (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z.1) : Type u) := by
  letI : Epi x.q := x.epi
  letI : x.F.IsFinitePresentation := x.isFinitePresentation
  exact Modules.module_finite_stalk_of_stalkLength_ne_top K (X := pullback π s) x.F z.2
    (Modules.stalkLength_ne_top_of_cartier (pullback.snd π s) x.q
      (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π s)) x.kerLocallyTrivial z.1)

/-- Each residue-weighted Weil multiplicity is the ground-field dimension
of the actual divisor quotient stalk. -/
theorem finrank_stalk_eq_stalkMultiplicity_mul_residueDeg
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (z : {z : (pullback π s : Scheme) // z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)}) :
    letI := Modules.stalkOverModule K (X := pullback π s) x.F z.1
    Module.finrank K (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z.1) : Type u) =
      x.stalkMultiplicity z.1 * (pullback π s).residueDeg K z.1 := by
  letI : Epi x.q := x.epi
  letI : x.F.IsFinitePresentation := x.isFinitePresentation
  letI := Modules.stalkOverModule K (X := pullback π s) x.F z.1
  have h := Modules.finrank_stalk_eq_stalkLength_mul_residueDeg K
    (X := pullback π s) x.F z.2
    (Modules.stalkLength_ne_top_of_cartier (pullback.snd π s) x.q
      (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π s)) x.kerLocallyTrivial z.1)
  rw [← x.coe_stalkMultiplicity z.1] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

/-- The degree of the effective Weil divisor is the sum of the dimensions
of its actual nonzero quotient stalks. This includes the residue weights
over an arbitrary base field. -/
theorem deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_sum_finrank_stalk
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    letI := fun z : (pullback π s : Scheme) =>
      Modules.stalkOverModule K (X := pullback π s) x.F z
    CurveDivisor.deg K x.effectiveWeilDivisor =
      ∑ z ∈ x.effectiveWeilDivisor.support,
        (Module.finrank K (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z.1) : Type u) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  letI := fun z : (pullback π s : Scheme) =>
    Modules.stalkOverModule K (X := pullback π s) x.F z
  unfold CurveDivisor.deg Finsupp.sum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  change (x.stalkMultiplicity z.1 : ℤ) * ((pullback π s).residueDeg K z.1 : ℤ) = _
  rw [finrank_stalk_eq_stalkMultiplicity_mul_residueDeg]
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul]

end Scheme.DivFamily

end AlgebraicGeometry
